[EN] We've got too many sloths in {@Rgn:30001$$Balder's Refuge}, and they're making our lives miserable. Yes, really.

Wipe out the {@LinkCreature:30#100#jittery sloths}, {@LinkCreature:30#110#sloth slashers}, and {@LinkCreature:30#120#languid sloths}.

Report to Raciba for compensation.
[ES] Tenemos demasiados perezosos en {@Rgn:30001$$Balder's Refuge} y nos están haciendo la vida imposible. Sí, en serio.

Aniquila a los {@LinkCreature:30#100#jittery sloths}, {@LinkCreature:30#110#sloth slashers} y {@LinkCreature:30#120#languid sloths}.

Preséntate ante Raciba para recibir tu compensación.

[EN] You're pretty much doom to sloths, eh?

Great job.

Gran trabajo.
